summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Eloísa Díaz Insunza (June 25, 1866 – November 1, 1950). It states that she was the first female medical student at the University of Chile and the first woman to become a doctor of medicine in Chile and in all of South America.
one_line: Eloísa Díaz Insunza was a Chilean pioneer who became the first woman to earn a medical degree in Chile and South America.
key_facts: Eloísa Díaz Insunza was born on June 25, 1866.
Eloísa Díaz Insunza died on November 1, 1950.
Eloísa Díaz was the first female medical student to attend the University of Chile.
Eloísa Díaz was the first woman to become a doctor of medicine in Chile.
Eloísa Díaz was the first woman to become a doctor of medicine on the entire continent of South America.
